author: Sofronio Chen
name: Print The Shot
description: Uploads finished shots in TCL print format to a local print server (DecentEspressoPrintTheShot). Shots are uploaded automatically when they finish; the page adds shot browsing and manual printing.

AutoUpload.label: Auto upload
AutoUpload.description: Upload shots automatically when they finish while the page is open

ServerUrl.label: Server address
ServerUrl.description: Print server host and port, e.g. 192.168.1.20:8000. Its web UI (shot list, charts, date filters) is at this address unless Web UI address says otherwise.

ServerEndpoint.label: Upload path
ServerEndpoint.description: Path on the server that accepts the shot POST

WebUiUrl.label: Web UI address
WebUiUrl.description: The print server's own page — shot list, charts, date filters. Open http://<this address>/ in a browser, or press Open WebUI on the plugin page, which opens exactly this. Leave empty to use the Server address above; set it when the web UI lives somewhere else, e.g. another machine or port.

MachineName.label: Machine name
MachineName.description: Identifier sent as machine_id to the server

MinSeconds.label: Minimum shot length
MinSeconds.description: Skip shots shorter than this many seconds

data.description: POST {url, shot} — proxies one upload attempt from the page (avoids browser CORS)
GET plugin version and load status

id.description: Id of the newly stored shot
